$comment: Out-of-band AVB trust-anchor pins. DEV-CHANNEL: hash-anchored, not signed. Regenerate deliberately (node scripts/gen-expected-anchors.mjs --write) and review the diff; never automatically from the tree you are verifying.

provenance.pinnedBy: checked-in, review-gated constant. A change to these digests is a reviewable diff. Not a signed root; not GrapheneOS-equivalent (whose public keys live in signed release metadata).
provenance.whatItProves: the shipped avb_pkmd.bin is byte-identical to a digest a human reviewed; it does not prove the images were signed with this key
